Container.Name: Jellydash
Container.Overview: A Jellyfin dashboard for current streams, play history, statistics, and optional notifications. This template runs Jellydash with SQLite. The mascot is based on an icon by Magnific from Flaticon.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Host port for the Jellydash web interface.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: SQLite database, logs, and runtime files. Back up this path.

Config.Name: Uploads
Config.Description: Uploaded images and other user files. Back up this path.

Config.Name: Jellyfin URL
Config.Description: Jellyfin address reachable from this container. Use a server IP or hostname, not localhost.

Config.Name: Jellyfin API key
Config.Description: API key from Jellyfin Dashboard, API Keys. Some statistics need an admin key.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone, for example Europe/Prague. Used for History and Statistics dates.

Config.Name: Database driver
Config.Description: SQLite mode for this single-container template. Leave as sqlite3.

Config.Name: Database file
Config.Description: SQLite file inside the Appdata mount. Leave at this path for a new install.

Config.Name: Login enabled
Config.Description: Set to true only after filling in both initial admin fields below.

Config.Name: Initial admin user
Config.Description: Initial username if login is enabled. Existing users are not changed on restart.

Config.Name: Initial admin password
Config.Description: Initial password if login is enabled. Change it inside Jellydash after setup.
